name: @vaultline/cli
description: Zero-trust context control for GitHub Copilot CLI — redacts secrets, PII and infrastructure detail out of file and shell tool results before they reach the model, and rehydrates them before anything is written back to disk.
//dependencies: The MCP stdio protocol is hand-rolled in jsonRpc.ts rather than pulled from @modelcontextprotocol/sdk. It is newline-delimited JSON-RPC 2.0 and we implement four methods; against that, every dependency here is one more package with read access to the developer's files and shell output, inside the tool whose entire purpose is keeping that content contained. @vaultline/core is the only dependency, matching core's own restraint.

scripts.test: npm run test:protocol && npm run test:redaction && npm run test:rehydrate && npm run test:reveal && npm run test:instructions && npm run test:prompt
